verbs.label: BACK
verbs.longLabel: Cancel placement / close browser / deselect / options menu

verbs.label: DELETE
verbs.notes: Can remove a whole multi-selection or building; undoable with Ctrl+Z, but confirm by default.

verbs.label: DUP + ADV
verbs.notes: Update 3 disabled Advance Move (and Duplicate) shortcuts while in Edit Building mode (S7).

verbs.label: ADV MOVE
verbs.notes: X is also "Toggle Advanced Move" in placement and "Lock Brush" in the scenery brush (S1).

verbs.label: EDIT
verbs.longLabel: Edit Building; Edit Coaster from a coaster InfoPanel
verbs.notes: R = "Edit Building" (S1); Update 3 restored R for "Edit Coaster" in coaster InfoPanels (S7).

verbs.label: SKIP
verbs.notes: Tab is also "Hide Panels" (camera view modes) and "Next Alignment Option" (placement) (S1).

verbs.label: RADIAL

binding.note: S1 says "Show Radial Menu: Alt"; hold-vs-tap not stated, so the key mirrors the deck press (down/up).

verbs.verify: Press and hold Alt in park view: does the radial stay only while held?
verbs.notes: Gamepad: hold Y (S13).

verbs.label: HIDE UI
verbs.notes: Right-side modifiers. Game Rant (S3) suggests users rebind it to a simpler key; read the user's rebinds.

verbs.label: SPEED
verbs.conflict: S1 (official) shows "0" (zero); Game Rant (S3) writes "O or 1, 2, 3", and Planet Coaster 1 used the letter O. Update 1 notes (S18) also give 0 to the Terrain tool. S1 is the best evidence.
verbs.verify: In park view press 0, then O: note which one changes the speed.

verbs.label: SPEED 5x
verbs.notes: Key 3 = x5 (not x3) per S1.

verbs.label: PATHS
verbs.verify: Press 8 in park view.

verbs.label: BRUSH TOOL
verbs.verify: Press 9 in park view.

verbs.label: TERRAIN
verbs.conflict: Update 1 notes (S18) map 0 to Terrain; the live controls page (S1) maps 0 to Change Simulation Speed. One of them is stale.
verbs.verify: Press 0 in park view: speed change or Terrain tool?

verbs.label: PAN FWD
verbs.notes: Update 1 (S18) also moves the camera with the arrow keys.

verbs.label: ROTATE L
verbs.notes: In freelook, Q is "Pan Camera Down" instead (S1).

verbs.label: ROTATE R
verbs.notes: In freelook, E is "Pan Camera Up" instead (S1).

verbs.label: FREELOOK
verbs.conflict: S1 also lists T as "Enter Visitor Camera Placement Mode" under Visitor Camera Mode; which one T does may depend on the mode.
verbs.verify: Press T in park view; note whether freelook or visitor-camera placement starts.

verbs.label: PANELS
verbs.notes: Tab hides the ride-camera overlay (S17, issue 67778).

verbs.label: UPLOAD BP
verbs.notes: Publishes to the workshop: only a direct press.

binding.note: Clicks at the cursor: aim with the mouse, press the key.

verbs.label: RESET HGT

binding.note: A tap of Shift resets; Shift + mouse Y adjusts height (S1).

verbs.conflict: S15 (Frontier path guide) tells PC players to hold Tab in one place and Shift in another to slope paths; S1 says Shift + mouse Y.

binding.note: Held while placing (S1: "Disable Path Joins: Ctrl").

verbs.label: BUILD

binding.note: The panel's "Place" / "Place ({Cost})" button (S16): cursor-free.

verbs.longLabel: Place the piece (then the next one)

verbs.notes: Disabled when the piece is unaffordable or invalid; Sight reads that state. Gamepad: A = Place (S13).

verbs.label: DELETE

altBindings.note: RMB = Delete Track Piece (S1), at the cursor.

verbs.notes: Safe, not confirm: one piece, undoable with Ctrl+Z (S1). A user preference can raise it to confirm.

binding.note: Additive track selection, at the cursor (S1).
S1: "Toggle Centre / Even Falloff: Shift". The logical button is a modifier (S16), so the key mirrors the deck press: hold while dragging, tap to toggle.
S1: "Toggle World / Relative Movement: Ctrl"; a modifier (S16).

verbs.label: GATE/STAIRS

binding.note: S1: "Toggle Gate / Stairs Entrance (Flumes Only): Ctrl" — same key as World/Relative.

verbs.conflict: Ctrl is listed for both World/Relative and Gate/Stairs (flumes only) in S1; meaning depends on what is selected.

verbs.label: ANGLE SNAP

binding.note: The Settings-tab Angle Snap tooltip shows the key of EditorsToggleRotationSnap (S16), the same action as "Toggle Angle Snap On / Off" (S1: P).

altBindings.note: UI route: Settings tab, then the Angle Snap tick box.

verbs.conflict: Launch week: P did nothing in the coaster builder (S6); fixed in Update 2 (S19, issue 69372). Update 1 (S18) says G for object angle snap; reports mention Space. Use the user's rebind if present.

userBindings.summary: Rebinds made on Settings > Mouse & Keyboard (4th tab) > Change are saved in Controls_remote.config.xml under <ControlBindings>. On this PC it is empty (all defaults). Logical button names are known from game data (S16: EditorsDelete, EditorsToggleRotationSnap, EditorsToggleTesting, …) and are the verbs' appAction; the XML nesting is inferred from the exe; no public example exists.

locations.note: One folder per Steam account id (never copy it). Same folder: Game_remote.config.xml (units, track-edit settings).

userBindings.entryShape: Inferred: <ControlBindings preset="Custom" version="N"><Bindings><LogicalButton><Name>…</Name><Binding><DeviceType>…</DeviceType><Key>…</Key><Modifier>…</Modifier><EventType>…</EventType></Binding></LogicalButton></Bindings></ControlBindings>. Element names exist in the exe (S11); nesting, attribute-vs-element and the logical button names are unverified. Planet Coaster 1 uses <LogicalControlRebinds/> instead.
userBindings.keyNameMap: Key names are probably the Input_KB_Key_* family (A–Z, 0–9, Space, Tab, Equals, Minus, Enter, Backspace, Escape, Apostrophe, Semicolon, Comma, Grave, LeftBracket, RightBracket, NonUSHash, Backslash, F1…) without the prefix: Equals → Equal, Grave → Backquote, LeftBracket → BracketLeft, Apostrophe → Quote. Unverified.
userBindings.readMode: Read-only; FileSystemWatcher on the Config folder; re-parse on change; if parsing fails, keep defaults and say so in the PI.
userBindings.verify: Ask the user to rebind one harmless action (Camera Torch L → K), quit to menu, then read the file read-only to capture the real shape and the logical button name; then reset to default.

layouts.rationale: The Coaster Console: place/undo/delete on top, piece types in the middle with the live RATINGS (E/F/N) key, test, ride cam and the Construction/Edit switch at the bottom; bank and pitch on layer 0 (push = level/flat), curve and length on layer 1 (push = straight/place); each widget shows its own dial (the horizon for bank).

Edit Mode keeps the same dial positions (muscle memory) but swaps length for smoothing strength (its widget shows the strength), and the keys become smooth / delete / modifiers plus the live RATINGS key (smoothing changes them).

All four shape dials at once, each strip segment showing its own value; the top row builds, the bottom row has chain lift, brakes, the live RATINGS (E/F/N) key and the ride cam (boosters/loops/specials/station move to page 2).
Time control on top, editing in the middle, camera utilities at the bottom; the camera is continuous so all four dial slots drive it, and the widgets carry the park HUD.
Direct speed keys fit the 4-wide top row; undo/redo/heatmaps/hide UI below; camera on the dials and the HUD on the strip.
Terrain has real keyboard steps (-/=, Shift, Ctrl), so size, intensity and hardness are true dials today; apply/inverse/undo stay under the right hand.
Three brush dials plus zoom, each with its value on the strip; apply and undo on the top row.
Place/rotate/undo on top, transform tools in the middle, the snap toggles below and cancel last; rotation in 90-degree steps is the left dial.
Path height (U/J) is a true keyboard step, so it is the left dial with push = reset height; place/join/undo on top.

conflicts: Simulation speed cycle: S1 (Frontier) "0" vs S3 (Game Rant) "O"; S1 wins.
T is listed both as "Toggle Freelook Camera" (Camera) and "Enter Visitor Camera Placement Mode" (Visitor Camera) in S1.
Ctrl is both "Toggle World / Relative Movement" and "Toggle Gate / Stairs Entrance (Flumes Only)" in the track editor (S1).
Path slopes/stairs: S1 Shift + mouse Y; S15 says hold Tab in the how-to box and Shift in the tip.
Q/E rotate the camera, but are down/up in freelook (S1).
gaps: No default keyboard binds for bank, slope, curve, length or piece types in the track editor (S1, S2, S14): the Coaster Console relies on Prism Sight (sightAdjust/sightClick) or on binds the user creates, if the rebinding page offers such rows.

Slider steps come from game data per piece and are not published (community builds use 11.25°/22.5°/45°/90°); per-step value is null until calibrated. Angle Snap stops start at 11.25°; whether this PC's saved 90 is a stop is unconfirmed.
Keys 0 and 8/9: the live controls page gives 0 to simulation speed, Update 1 notes give 8/9/0 to Paths/Brush/Terrain; verify in game.

The real rebind XML shape is unconfirmed (logical names are known from game data); one test rebind settles it. Default keys of Start/Stop Testing and Change Smoothing Mode are unknown (possibly unbound).

Every Sight region is unverified until the calibration recordings exist. Injected input: the engine's RawInput driver explicitly handles NULL-device (SendInput) input by matching it to a real device (S16), and a commercial Galleon profile ships on default binds (S20); still untested here. Levers: -loginput, -legacykeyboard, -legacymouse launch options (S16). Remote Desktop / Remote Play input fails (S17).
Gamepad-only builder functions: "Toggle Track Edit Controls" (X) and stick track movement (S13) have no listed keyboard equivalent.
notes: Screenshots that settle the gaps: (1) Main Menu > Settings > 4th tab (Mouse & Keyboard) > Change: every page, especially any track/coaster section, including blank rows; (2) the track editor with a piece selected, Edit menu open on the right, Angle Snap visible; (3) the ride panel after a Test (ratings, G-forces).
The user plays in feet and mph (S10); readouts must keep the game's units.

Competition: an Elgato Marketplace "Planet Coaster 1 & 2 for Galleon" profile (S20) maps the default keys only. Prism's edge is the Sight-driven shaping dials, closed-loop level/flat/straight and the live E/F/N + G readouts.

Fastest keyboard route to test first: click a slider thumb, then press Left/Right; the UI code steps a focused slider by one step on arrow keys (S16). If it works on mouse and keyboard, the dials become "focus once, then arrows".

Input timing (inference, untested in PC2): send scan codes (keyMode scancode) and hold each key 40–100 ms. A Cobra-engine Elite Dangerous Stream Deck plugin (github.com/mhwlng/streamdeck-elite) holds 40 ms, and VoiceAttack advises ~0.1 s against dropped keys. If keys are still missed, -legacykeyboard / -legacymouse helped older Frontier games, with side effects. See notes/planet-coaster-2-builder-ui.md §6.6.
